title: スプリンターズSの後に・虹をも超えて

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I come out of the race as the grand victor! Taiki may beat me when it comes to toughness, but I win out when it comes to speed! However…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That was a 1,200-meter race on Japan's short turf over a firm track… All the conditions were tilted in my favor. I can't very well say I surpassed the world champion in light of that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run against Taiki in the Mile Championship! My chances of winning are extremely close to zero!
